risk_if_not_implemented: Without Cryptographic Exception Register, data in transit and at rest may be exposed through weak, misconfigured or compromised cryptographic protections. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Statement of Applicability (SOA)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to produce a Statement of Applicability (SOA), or similar document, for compliance-related scoping activities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Statement of Applicability (SOA) (CPL-25) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Cryptographic Exception Register (QTS-04.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Remediation
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to remediate risks to an acceptable level.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Remediation (RSK-17) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Cryptographic Exception Register (QTS-04.1) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses and prioritizing critical remediations. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
